anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.property_overview_150_words: Discover SANCCOB Gqeberha, a vital seabird rescue and rehabilitation center nestled in the scenic Cape Recife. Witness the dedicated efforts to save and release marine birds, including the iconic African Penguin. Engage with passionate educators, observe rehabilitation in action, and learn about critical conservation initiatives. This unique sanctuary offers a heartwarming and educational experience for families and nature enthusiasts, connecting you directly with Gqeberha's rich marine biodiversity and local commitment to wildlife welfare. Support a cause while enjoying an unforgettable visit.
